CustomField.description: Indicates the Name on the Certificate provided by the customer matches with the Current Customer Name in the Profile
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Birth & Change of Name certificate - the ID must show the customer's current profile name as a previous name. Marriage Certificate - the ID must show the customer's current profile name as either: 1) one of the married parties to change to the married name; or 2) the first/middle name/s of one of the married parties AND that the last name is derived from the married parties' to return to their former name. Please refer to the procedural guide for more information.
CustomField.label: Certificate shows current Contact Name
